full_judgment: 2. Present petitioner No. 1, Mossamat Jesmin Akhter was the wife of opposite party A.S.M. Moniruzzaman (Babu). A S M Moniruzzaman (Babu) was the husband. This opposite party A.S.M. Moniruzzaman (Babu) instituted a suit being Family Suit No. 2 of 1998 praying for a decree (I) declaring that the talaknama registered on 2.4.1998 in the office of the Marriage Registrar, No. 5 Decreer Char Union, Faridpur is fraudulent, void and illegal and (2) for restitution of conjugal life between the plaintiff and the defendant No. 1. On 20.3.1997 marriage between the plaintiff-opposite party and the defendant petitioner No. 1 was solemnised in Barisal Town. The plaintiff opposite party instituted a suit in the Court of Assistant Judge and Family Court, Wazipur, Barisal against Mossamat Jesmin Akhter, former wife as defendant No. I and she is the principal defendant. Then Md. Azimuddin Ahmed, father of the defendant petitioner No. 1, Khodeja Begum, mother of the defendant petitioner No. 1. Mohammad Murad, brother of the defendant petitioner No. I and M. Abul Kalam, brother of the defendant petitioner No. I have been impleaded as parties in the Family Suit. It appears that the plaintiff opposite party instituted the suit giving address of principal defendant No. 1 at Bharsha Kathi, police station Wazipur, District Bakergong at present residing at Dakhin Alipur, police station Kotwali, Faridpur Sadar, Post and District Faridpur, proforma defendant Nos. 2 to 5 have been impleaded and their addresses have been given also showing village Dakhin Alipur, police station Kotwali, Post and District Faridpur.
